findings.detail: On a clone of the seeded source with sale/purchase/stock/account installed (as odoo_src), `-u uom,product` on run-branch tip 72fca61 fails to load the registry: `Module loading account failed: file account/security/ir.access.csv could not be processed: Invalid domain [('company_id', 'in', company_ids)]: product.product is stored in MongoDB: no SQL for field 'uom_id' (not in _shadow_columns)` (d6-update-traceback.log). Not a data-parity defect (recon PASS stands); needs its own storage-path ticket.

The three `_table_query` reports the contract lists as D6 readers raise `NotImplementedError: product.product is stored in MongoDB: no SQL for field 'uom_id' (not in _shadow_columns)` from `Query.__getitem__` (odoo/orm/query.py:431 via Many2one.property_to_sql, fields_relational.py:499; sale_report.py:197 `table.product_id.uom_id`): sale.report, purchase.report, account.invoice.report `search_count([])` all fail, reproduced on a plain clone with no update and no writes (d6-readers.log). `uom_id` is an `_inherits`-delegated product.template field; both `product_product.product_tmpl_id` and `product_template.uom_id` are shadow columns, but the delegated field is checked against product.product's own `_shadow_columns` before the `_inherits` join. purchase.bill.line.match, stock.quant, stock.move and the ORM `_inherits` read work. The product + uom test database does not install sale/purchase/account, which is why the suites show 160/161.

The 3 PostgreSQL views (report_stock_quantity 5263 rows, stock_avco_report 7, vendor_delay_report 10) exist and return rows on the clone, but the `-u uom,product` that would reduce product_product/product_template to shadow tables rolled back (finding above), so they were read from the full PostgreSQL tables; not evidence that the views work on the shadow tables. Open until the storage-path defect is fixed.

product + uom suites on the fresh odoo_w2v_test database: 1 failed, 0 error(s) of 161 tests; the one failure is test_get_closest_possible_combinations (0.71 s, limit 0.5 s), the Atlas-latency timing test accepted by d-w2-timing-test = accept-known. The unprefixed collections kept their counts throughout.

The seven wave 1 collections still reconcile: uom PASS (T1 3 / T2 8 / T3 30), product-taxonomy PASS from the verifier's seeded clone (T1 10 / T2 13 / T3 13 / T4 4), product-attributes PASS (T1 8 / T2 16 / T3 124 / T4 2) with the accepted warning `UNVERIFIED collection updateProductAttributeValue: 0 source rows` (merge_eligible=false on that run for that reason only; the committed wave 1 results carry the same warning).

The committed batch result `.migration/recon/w2-b01.json` has `pr_url: ""`, so `preflight.py --grade` on it verbatim downgrades the batch to FAIL/missing_pr and then rejects this verifier result (`unexpected verdicts for w2-b01`). Graded with the batch's PR URL filled in (https://github.com/Cognition-Partner-Workshops/odoo/pull/33, a scratch copy outside the repo), `--grade ... --verify verify-result.json --run-id UNT11-41` exits 0: batch PASS, merge_eligible, `verify_problems: []`, `wave 2 OK: 1 batches, manifest_sha 0b73271c13bf`. The verifier did not edit the worker's batch file.
